name: study-align
description: StudyAlign monorepo (backend, frontends, shared client library).

scripts.build:admin: npm run build:lib && npm run build -w study-align-admin-frontend
scripts.build:study: npm run build:lib && npm run build -w study-align-framework
scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build -w study-align-admin-frontend && npm run build -w study-align-framework
scripts.start:admin: npm run build:lib && npm start -w study-align-admin-frontend
scripts.start:study: npm run build:lib && npm start -w study-align-framework
